name: payloads
description: Reusable Electron payload packaging, persistence, audit, and discovery workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Electron payload, persistence, audit, and candidate-discovery workflows.
interface.longDescription: Reusable workflows for repackaging Electron apps, preserving Squirrel install continuity, auditing local or named Electron targets, and identifying practical patchable candidates.
defaultPrompt: Use Payloads to repackage a newer Electron app into an older Squirrel delivery chain.
